list.text: Ecruteak City Pokémon Gym Leader: Morty\nThe Mystic Seer of the Future
Burned Tower\nIt was destroyed by a mysterious fire.
Please stay away, as it is unsafe.
You have business with the Gym Leader?
Morty, the Gym Leader, has gone to the Burned Tower.
Sorry, but you can't enter.\nHo ho ho
If you go west from this city, you'll reach a port called Olivine City.
When you Pokémon learns Surf, you can go out to the ocean from Route 40 without a ship!
I'm going to rehearse at the Dance Theater. Care to join me?
Kimono Girls are always rehearsing their dances at the Dance Theater there.
Ecruteak used to have two towers, one in the east and one in the west.
Oh!\nThat's a nice Pokémon you're walking with! They make you feel uplifted, don't they?
They give us the hope of the light, so to speak.
Speaking of the light, I heard something about the Lighthouse in Olivine.
The Pokémon that serves as the beacon has fallen ill.\nSounds like it's in trouble.
The tower that used to be here...\nI heard that it used to be much taller before it was burned by a fire.
